riddles: The more you take, the more you leave behind.|Footsteps|Gold|Time|Breath
I have cities, but no houses; forests, but no trees; water, but no fish.|A map|A dream|A mirror|A painting
What gets wet while it dries?|A towel|A river|A cloud|A jug
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. The wind brings me to life.|An echo|A ghost|A bell|A song
It has teeth, but it never bites.|A comb|A wolf|A dragon|A shark
What has a neck but no head?|A bottle|A swan|A knight|A giraffe
The more of it there is, the less you see.|Darkness|Light|Gold|Torches
The one who makes it doesn't tell. The one who takes it doesn't know. The one who knows it doesn't take it.|Counterfeit money|A secret|Poison|A curse
